title: Live Container Integration Suite Withheld on Small Host
description: 17 container-dependent integration tests in backend/tests/integration/ require a live PostgreSQL 16 server with pgvector and Qdrant. Execution was withheld because host available physical RAM (1237.6 MB) is below the mandatory 2048 MB memory safety threshold.
closure_requirement: Execute on CI runner or host with >= 2048 MB free physical RAM.

title: Source-Derived PDF Word/Span Bounding Box Extraction Deferred
description: PDF citation highlighting renders preserved ingestion chunk bounding boxes with synthetic US Letter geometry fallback. Exact word/span extraction via PyMuPDF get_text('words') is deferred to post-M05.
